mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "WORKER" JOIN "MEMBER" USING (MEMBER_NO) WHERE MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND WORKER_NICKNAME = #{workerNickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_TEL = #{memberTel}
mapper.update: UPDATE WORKER SET WORKER_NICKNAME = #{workerNickname}, WORKER_ADDRESS = #{workerAddress}, WORKER_MBTI = #{workerMbti}, PROFILE_IMG = #{profileImg} WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_WRITE_DATE, BOARD_READ_COUNT FROM "BOARD" WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND BOARD_CODE != 1 AND BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N'
